definition: Phonetic Search Technology (PST) is a method of speech recognition.
details: An audio signal of speech is broken down into series of phonemes, which can be used to identify words. A string of six phonemes for example, “_B _IY _T _UW _B _IY,” represent the acronym “B2B”.
story: Think of a grammar teacher who never memorized a rule but can still tell you when a sentence sounds wrong. The machine learns language the way you did — by hearing so much of it that the patterns sink in. It figures out meaning by noticing which words like to travel together. The machine learns to read between the lines by reading an impossible number of lines. And that is Phonetic search technology — teaching a machine to read between the lines.
